current_project_meta.title: Denoising Diffusion Model on MNIST
current_project_meta.description: Build a DDPM from scratch in PyTorch on MNIST - forward noising schedule with closed-form sampling, a small U-Net noise predictor, training on the simplified loss, then ancestral sampling and a noise-schedule comparison
daily_plan: Forward diffusion process - linear and cosine beta schedules, closed-form q(x_t|x_0), visualize progressive noising of MNIST digits

Ancestral sampling, cosine vs linear schedule comparison, sample grid, project README
